text:
Jordan: quick q — should our patch tags be human-friendly like v1.4.2 or always include commit-sha (v1.4.2+g1a2b3c4)? thinking about release notes and backports
Ashok: +1 for human-readable, but we need reproducibility. the sha suffix makes it unambiguous.
Samira: i vote for v1.4.2+sha8. show plain semver in docs/UI but keep full tag in CI and changelogs :thumbsup:
Maria: real concern — some of our parsers treat '+' as non-semver and fail. we did hit this in analytics pipeline last month.
Jordan: right. deploybot currently accepts buildmeta, but releasebot's semver parser strips it which breaks linking.
release-bot: notify: deploy queued for v1.4.2 (ci/12345) — tag: v1.4.2+g1a2b3c4 — see https://ci.internal/12345/logs
Ashok: proposal: follow semver build metadata: <semver>+<short-sha>. e.g., v1.4.2+g1a2b3c4. UI shows "v1.4.2 (g1a2b3c4)" so humans get both.
Jordan: propose policy shorthand: canonical tag = semver + '+' + 8-char sha. changelog anchors = semver only (no +meta) for readability. refer to canonical tag in release notes and audits.
Samira: also for backports/patch bumps we should keep a patch suffix: e.g., v1.4.2.patch1+g1a2b3c4 so it's obvious it's a backported patch.
Jordan: snippet for releasebot config i had in mind:
```
TAG_FORMAT: "v{MAJOR}.{MINOR}.{PATCH}{PATCHSUFFIX}+{SHORT_SHA}"
DISPLAY_FMT: "v{MAJOR}.{MINOR}.{PATCH}{PATCHSUFFIX} ({SHORT_SHA})"
CHANGE_ANCHOR: "v{MAJOR}.{MINOR}.{PATCH}{PATCHSUFFIX}"
```
Ashok: i can add a compatibility shim in CI that strips "+<meta>" when we need to compare semver ranges, so we don't rewrite a bunch of parsers.
Maria: can releasebot emit both the canonical tag and a semver-only anchor in the changelog? that would help auditors and SRE lookups.
Jordan: yes — will implement. action items: Jordan -> update docs and releasebot config PR; Ashok -> add semver-compat shim to CI; Samira -> add test cases for backport tags in our release tests; Maria -> confirm analytics pipeline accepts the display format.
Samira: timeline? targeting next change window Thursday 14:00 UTC.
Ashok: seems feasible. i'll prioritize shim this week.
Maria: i'll run quick analytics smoke test once shim is ready.
Jordan: great, consensus reached. we'll standardize on semver+short-sha for canonical tags, semver-only anchors in changelogs, and a display format for UIs. thanks all :white_check_mark:
